landing.text: School, coaching, and home tuition organized in one place. Instant AI revision quizzes from handwritten notes and clear weekly progress insights.
landing.text_8: Designed specifically for busy parents and curious learners to stay aligned without academic friction.
landing.text_10: Effortlessly record school lectures, private tuition sessions, and self-study topics in under 60 seconds.
landing.text_12: Snap photos of class notebooks. Smart OCR extracts topics and generates instant revision quizzes with feedback.
landing.text_14: See weekly study hours by source, topic strengths and weaknesses, and consistency heatmap in seconds.
landing.text_16: Distraction-free student portal where children can answer interactive quizzes, track streaks, and build learning habits.
landing.text_17: Optimized for Bangla handwriting, English text, and mixed formulas from everyday student notebooks.
landing.text_19: Manage weekly tutor schedules, handle class reschedules gracefully, and stay ahead of upcoming sessions.
landing.text_22: Requires less than 2 minutes of your daily time while keeping you deeply in touch with learning.
landing.text_24: Set up weekly school & tutor schedules. Quickly log topics covered after each session in 45 seconds.
